entities.summary: Alexander, a notable figure in the history of Iran, associated with Seleucid and Parthian Iran (330 BCE–247 BCE). Preceded by Seleucid Hellenistic Period and Seleucid Empire. Their legacy influenced Battle of Carrhae — Parthians destroy Roman army under Crassus (53 BC) and Parthia and Rome fight repeatedly over Armenia and Mesopotamia.
